question: The simple interest on ₹35,000 is ₹12,600. The rate of interest per annum (in %) and the time (in years) are equal. What is the rate?
solution: SI = P × R × R ÷ 100, so R² = 12,600 × 100 ÷ 35,000 = 36. R = 6% (and the time is 6 years).

question: A sum of money triples itself in 12 years at simple interest. In how many years will it become 5 times itself at the same rate?
solution: In 12 years the interest is 2 times the sum (the rate is 16⅔%). To become 5 times itself the interest must be 4 times the sum, which takes 12 × 4/2 = 24 years.
questionHi: कोई राशि साधारण ब्याज पर 12 वर्ष में तिगुनी हो जाती है। उसी दर पर वह कितने वर्ष में 5 गुनी हो जाएगी?
solutionHi: 12 वर्ष में ब्याज राशि का 2 गुना है (दर 16⅔%)। 5 गुनी होने के लिए ब्याज राशि का 4 गुना होना चाहिए, जिसमें 12 × 4/2 = 24 वर्ष लगेंगे।
